metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: This features a heartwarming ensemble cast and smart, optimistic humor similar to Community and Ted Lasso.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A quintessential British comedy that captures the awkward, eccentric vibes found in Peep Show and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A fast-paced, lighthearted workplace comedy with the same wholesome energy and joke density as Scrubs and The Good Place.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A grounded yet quirky family animation that pairs well with the dry warmth of King of the Hill and The Simpsons.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Rich with meta-commentary and callbacks, it mirrors the high-concept writing style you enjoyed in Community.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: A hilarious, low-stakes British reality competition that matches the casual, background-friendly fun of Gogglebox.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A cult classic British comedy about pop-culture-obsessed roommates, fitting perfectly with your love for Dirk Gently and Community.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A mockumentary about vampires that blends the surreal sci-fi/fantasy elements of Futurama with sharp comedic timing.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: An uplifting, feel-good story about character growth that starts as a comedy and evolves into a heartwarming journey like Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the Rick and Morty team, this offers high-concept sci-fi absurdity with a slightly more sitcom-friendly structure.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A smart, dense parody of adventure cartoons that fans of Futurama's world-building and Rick and Morty's humor will love.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A cynical, dry, and absurdist British sitcom that matches the tone of Peep Show and Goodness Gracious Me.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: A fast-talking, joke-a-minute workplace comedy that aligns with the professional satire seen in Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy that focuses on the 'background' crew, perfectly combining the vibes of Futurama and One Piece.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: Features the same sharp, irreverent dialogue and chaotic ensemble energy found in It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: An action-packed, humorous take on the superhero genre that matches the irreverent, fun tone of Fallout.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A charming, lighthearted ensemble comedy with a supernatural premise, providing great 'comfort' viewing.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A hilarious, high-energy sitcom about teenagers in Northern Ireland with the same comedic pacing as New Girl.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: A workplace comedy set in a video game studio, appealing to the tech-humor found in Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: An underrated corporate satire with surreal elements that fans of Silicon Valley and Community will appreciate.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A quirky sci-fi comedy about an alien trying to blend in, matching the eccentric character energy of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A dry, musical comedy about two New Zealanders in NYC, echoing the artistic and comedic tone of Master of None.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cynical yet hilarious show about caterers in LA, perfect for fans of the ensemble chaos in It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A lighthearted space adventure that balances comedy and sci-fi drama, ideal for fans of Futurama and Doctor Who.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: An energetic, chaotic friendship comedy that matches the 'unfiltered' humor of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: A British comedy set in a world where everyone has superpowers except the protagonist, blending your tastes for British wit and sci-fi.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: A highly watchable, lighthearted workplace sitcom that serves as excellent comfort and background content.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A heartwarming family sitcom with sharp writing and relatable dynamics, similar to the family life in The Simpsons.

metas.name: People Just Do Nothing
metas.description: A British mockumentary that captures the cringe-comedy brilliance of Peep Show and the gritty fun of Brassic.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: An absurdist British comedy with an eccentric lead, appealing to fans of Goodness Gracious Me and Peep Show.

metas.name: Jury Duty
metas.description: A unique, heartwarming hidden-camera comedy that is incredibly uplifting and easy to watch.

metas.name: The Great British Bake Off
metas.description: The ultimate relaxing background show; it provides a similar feel-good atmosphere to Ted Lasso and Gogglebox.

metas.name: Firefly
metas.description: A fun, character-driven space western that fits your interest in Sci-Fi/Fantasy adventures like One Piece and Fallout.

metas.name: The Tick
metas.description: A surreal, comedic take on superheroes that matches the whimsical and weird tone of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: High-velocity political satire with some of the best insult-comedy on TV, matching the wit of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Inside Job
metas.description: An animated series about a shadow government that captures the conspiracy-theory humor of Rick and Morty.

metas.name: This Country
metas.description: A brilliant British mockumentary that finds humor in the mundane, much like the grounded moments in Brassic.

metas.name: Man Like Mobeen
metas.description: A comedy-drama that balances lighthearted friendship with cultural insight, similar to Goodness Gracious Me and Brassic.

metas.name: Dave
metas.description: A semi-autobiographical comedy about a rapper that leans into surrealist humor and personal growth like Master of None.

metas.name: The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel
metas.description: A visually stunning and fast-paced comedy with sharp dialogue that offers high-quality, uplifting entertainment.
